lessons.title: Where is the... ?

items.example: Où est la gare ?
items.exampleMeaning: Where is the train station?

items.example: La gare est près d'ici.
items.exampleMeaning: The train station is near here.

items.example: Tournez à gauche au feu.
items.exampleMeaning: Turn left at the traffic light.

items.example: La boulangerie est à droite.
items.exampleMeaning: The bakery is on the right.

items.example: Allez tout droit jusqu'au bout de la rue.
items.exampleMeaning: Go straight ahead to the end of the street.

items.example: Le parc est près de l'école.
items.exampleMeaning: The park is near the school.

lessons.tip: Use 'où est...' to ask for the location of a place. Remember to use the correct article (la, le) for feminine and masculine nouns.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Hello, where is the train station?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: The train station is near here.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Merci ! C'est à gauche ou à droite ?
dialogue.meaning: Thank you! Is it to the left or to the right?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: It's to the right.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: And the park?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Allez tout droit et le parc est près de l'école.
dialogue.meaning: Go straight ahead and the park is near the school.

scenario.brief: You are asking a local for directions. Start with 'Où est la gare ?' and ask for more places if needed.
scenario.goal: You need to find the train station and the park.

lessons.title: Giving Directions

items.example: Tournez à gauche au coin.
items.exampleMeaning: Turn left at the corner.

items.example: Allez tout droit jusqu'à la rue principale.
items.exampleMeaning: Go straight to the main street.

items.example: Traversez la rue ici.
items.exampleMeaning: Cross the street here.

items.example: Suivez cette route.
items.exampleMeaning: Follow this road.

items.example: Continuez jusqu'à la gare.
items.exampleMeaning: Continue until the train station.

items.example: Vous arrivez à la boulangerie.
items.exampleMeaning: You arrive at the bakery.

lessons.tip: When giving directions, use the imperative form of the verb. It is direct and clear.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: How to get to the bakery?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Suivez cette route et tournez à droite.
dialogue.meaning: Follow this road and turn right.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: And after?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Continuez tout droit et traversez la rue.
dialogue.meaning: Continue straight ahead and cross the street.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Thank you very much!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Vous arriverez à la boulangerie après ça.
dialogue.meaning: You will arrive at the bakery after that.

scenario.brief: You are asking for directions to the bakery. Use 'Comment aller à la boulangerie ?' and listen to the directions.
scenario.goal: You need to understand how to get to the bakery.

lessons.title: Finding Places

items.example: Il y a un restaurant près de la gare.
items.exampleMeaning: There is a restaurant near the train station.

items.example: Le musée est très intéressant.
items.exampleMeaning: The museum is very interesting.

items.example: La pharmacie est ouverte le dimanche.
items.exampleMeaning: The pharmacy is open on Sundays.

items.example: Le supermarché est à côté de la boulangerie.
items.exampleMeaning: The supermarket is next to the bakery.

items.example: L'église est au centre du village.
items.exampleMeaning: The church is in the center of the village.

items.example: Le parc est parfait pour se détendre.
items.exampleMeaning: The park is perfect for relaxing.

lessons.tip: When asking about places, use 'Il y a...' to indicate that something exists. This helps you find what you need.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Where is a restaurant?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Il y a un restaurant près de la gare.
dialogue.meaning: There is a restaurant near the train station.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: And a museum?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Le musée est au centre du village.
dialogue.meaning: The museum is in the center of the village.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Thank you for your help!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Je vous en prie, bonne journée !
dialogue.meaning: You’re welcome, have a nice day!

scenario.brief: You are searching for a restaurant and a museum. Ask about both places.
scenario.goal: You need to find both a restaurant and a museum.

lessons.title: Using Directions

items.example: Le supermarché est à côté de la pharmacie.
items.exampleMeaning: The supermarket is next to the pharmacy.

items.example: Le parc est derrière l'église.
items.exampleMeaning: The park is behind the church.

items.example: La boulangerie est devant le musée.
items.exampleMeaning: The bakery is in front of the museum.

items.example: La pharmacie est entre le restaurant et le supermarché.
items.exampleMeaning: The pharmacy is between the restaurant and the supermarket.

items.example: Le café est au coin de la rue.
items.exampleMeaning: The café is at the corner of the street.

items.example: Le parc est sur la droite.
items.exampleMeaning: The park is on the right.

lessons.tip: Use prepositions like 'à côté de', 'derrière', and 'devant' to describe the position of places. This helps you give clear directions.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Where is the park?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: The park is behind the church.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: And the bakery?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: La boulangerie est devant le musée.
dialogue.meaning: The bakery is in front of the museum.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Thank you, it's very clear!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I'm happy to help!

scenario.brief: You are asking for the location of the park and the bakery. Use the new words to ask about their positions.
scenario.goal: You need to find out where the park and bakery are.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Where is the train station?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: The train station is near here.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: How to get to the museum?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Allez tout droit et tournez à gauche.
dialogue.meaning: Go straight and turn left.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Il y a un restaurant à côté de la pharmacie ?
dialogue.meaning: Is there a restaurant next to the pharmacy?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Oui, le restaurant est à côté de la pharmacie.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, the restaurant is next to the pharmacy.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Where is the park?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: The park is behind the church.

scenario.brief: You are asking for directions to various places. Use the phrases you've learned to find the train station, museum, restaurant, and park.
scenario.goal: You need to find all the places you are looking for.
